steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Technology in sport: The use of scientific and digital innovations to improve officiating decisions, enhance performance, advance equipment design, and increase safety. Technology has transformed sport at every level, from grassroots to elite competition. | Balanced View: Technology has significantly improved accuracy, safety and performance in sport. However, it has also introduced new problems including cost inequality, delays and a diminished human element. The key challenge is finding the right balance between using technology to support sport and allowing it to dominate sport. | PE Exam Tips — Technology in Sport: 1.
